whatsapp-location-001.description: This screen is asking you to choose a person to share your location with.
steps: Check the name at the top of the chat so you know who you are talking to.
Choose Send your current location for a one-time share, or Share live location to share while you move.
Only continue if you want that person to see your location.
whatsapp-location-001.safety_note: Never share a password, one-time code (OTP), or PIN shown on a screen.

questions.text: What is this screen asking me to do?
questions.answer: It is showing location-sharing choices. You can send your current location once or share it live for a period of time.

questions.text: What should I check before I continue?
questions.answer: Check the chat name and make sure you want that person to know your location.

gmail-attachment-001.description: This screen lets you write a new email and add the recipient and subject.
steps: Add a short subject that describes your email.
Use the paperclip icon when you are ready to choose a file to attach.
gmail-attachment-001.safety_note: Never share a password, one-time code (OTP), or PIN shown on a screen.

questions.text: What is this screen asking me to do?
questions.answer: It is a new email. You can enter who it is for and a subject before writing your message.

questions.text: What should I check before I continue?
questions.answer: Check the recipient address and make sure you selected the right file before sending.
